title: Mask leakage in U-shaped split federated learning: code
description: Code for the paper "Labels Do Not Stay Local: Mask Leakage in U-Shaped Split Federated Learning for Medical Image Segmentation": the split federated U-Net (PyTorch), the image- and mask-leakage attacks, the analysis scripts that produce every table and figure, and the Kaggle run plan. Result files, data splits and pre-registration documents are archived in a separate data record. No images are included; the datasets are available from their owners.
